label: A New Friend and Club Selection

lines.text: The school bell rings.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's all for today's class.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Good work, everyone.
After Privaty leaves the classroom,
the previously quiet room regains its liveliness in an instant.
And...
*Click*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Let's eat lunch.
Arcana takes out her lunchbox, a sight that has become familiar by now.
But... there is a new addition today.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Ugh... today's lesson wasn't easy.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Really? I thought it was manageable.
You were just doodling in your book, Arcana.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Keep it down.
Thanks to Arcana becoming fast friends with Amy,
the three of us now hang out during lunch and after school.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Amy! Amy!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What are you doing after school today?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I don't really have any plans.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: What about you, Arcana?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName} and I were gonna sing some karaoke.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I mean we were planning to...!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But I should probably go sort out the library. It'll be bad if I put it off any longer.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Right. You came to manage the library, didn't you?
I haven't actually seen you working in the library.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Why don't we go together? I'll help.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Really?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Sure. I've been wanting to take a good look around the library anyway.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Great! Thanks!
You really shouldn't coddle her like that. She'll end up spoiled.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Wow. That's exactly what Phantom says.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Mmm...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: From what I've heard about this Phantom person, I kind of feel a sense of kinship...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I finally make a friend my own age, and you're saying something like that?!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Huh? Really?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: You seem so outgoing, I thought you'd have lots of friends.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Uh... well...
You'll realize how weird she is once you know her.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What's that supposed to mean?!
Arcana lightly smacks my shoulder.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Hehe. I think I get what you mean.
Amy picks up a piece of vegetable tempura and takes a bite.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}, you've known Arcana for a long time, right?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Was she always like this?
Yeah. Isn't she adorable?
Wait, did you just call me by my name too...?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: *Cough, cough*
I pat Arcana's back as she chokes.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Just eat this.
Arcana puffs out her cheeks and feeds me some inari sushi.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Oh? Am I not supposed to?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: That's how Arcana addresses you, so I figured I would too.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}, here.
Arcana feeds me some inari sushi with a playful smile.
Mmm...
Seeing how readily I accept the sushi, Amy lets out a small laugh.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Is it good?
It is.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.
After the meal ends in a pleasant atmosphere
Arcana tidies up the lunchboxes and plops a sheet of paper onto the desk.
"Club Activity Application Form?"

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yes. We said we'd start a club last time, remember?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's time to decide.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: A club, huh...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: There are two choices.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: A photography club or a divination club!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: A photography club?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yup. A club where we take lots of photos.
I-is that so...
Amy studies the camera Arcana takes out, lost in thought.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And the divination club would be...?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Hmm.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Actually, what exactly would we do?
Fortune-telling, I suppose?
With tarot cards or crystal balls and stuff.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That's... true...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But is that all we would do...?
Arcana points to the application form.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So what do we write here in the activities section?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: "We will predict the fate of the world, and read {AccountData.NickName}'s love fortune."

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Stuff like that? Hmm...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So which do you prefer, Amy?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'm not sure... I don't really know much about divination or occult stuff.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Really? I was kind of hoping the three of us could run the club together...
Arcana glances at me.
Do whatever you want, Arcana.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Yeah. I don't really mind either way.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I-I'm not very good at choosing things like this...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmmmmm...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ah. This won't do.
Arcana grabs her bag and stands up.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Arcana?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Let's grab something good to eat and think about it some more!
Arcana hauls Amy and me to our feet,
and swiftly ushers us out of the classroom.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm...
Arcana continues to mull it over even after we get to the cafe.
Is it really that hard to decide?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You only get one chance to choose.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If we try to do both, we'll just end up half-committing to each.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And then... no, things just wouldn't work out.
Arcana stirs the remaining ice in her cup with a straw.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... {AccountData.NickName}.
Yes?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You pick...
Let's go with the photography club.
I think the divination club would be better.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Were you interested in photography too, {AccountData.NickName}?
I'm starting to get into it. Arcana gave me a camera as a gift before.
I take out the camera Arcana gave me from my bag.
And...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So, photography club it is! You'll join too, right, Amy?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Oh, sure. Sounds fun.
Somehow it feels like Arcana wants Amy to join more than Amy does herself...
But I decide not to mention anything.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Then go ahead and write your name here.
Arcana holds out the application form.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You can be the club president, {AccountData.NickName}. As for the advisor...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmm... I'll put down Miss Privaty for now.
I'm the club president?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yup!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Have you told Miss Privaty about any of this?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Not yet, why?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Divination club, huh?
Arcana beams, then glances over at Amy, subtly gauging her reaction.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Er... you said you weren't that interested in it, right, Amy?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Mmm...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: You need at least three people to start a club, right?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'll put my name down for now.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, okay!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: But I'm not planning on actually participating.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'm not particularly interested in divination...
When Amy whispers something to Arcana,
Arcana's face turns bright red.
...? What is it?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... N-nothing. I-it's nothing.
And so, we write our names on the club application form.
While Amy writes her name last, Arcana fidgets with my hand.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... {AccountData.NickName}.
Hmm?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Thank you. For indulging me every time.
I'm the best, aren't I?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Pfft. Hearing you say that yourself makes me not want to admit it.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: By the way...
Amy, finishes writing her name, puts the pen away, and suddenly speaks up.
Yeah?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: What about the library?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh.
